t.E228.agn: Sulphites are among the substances that must be indicated on the label as allergens in the EU when present at more than 10 mg per kilogram (or litre); they may cause reactions in people with asthma. In its 2022 assessment EFSA withdrew the former temporary daily intake limit (0.7 mg/kg, as SO₂) because data were insufficient, did not set a new limit in its place, and reported a safety concern in high-consuming groups.
t.E228.body: In the stomach and intestine, sulphites reach an equilibrium between the sulphite, bisulphite and sulphur dioxide forms; they are largely (70–97%) absorbed from the intestine. Absorbed sulphite is rapidly converted to sulphate by the enzyme sulphite oxidase, mainly in the liver and small intestine (half-life in humans about 15 minutes); even so, up to a quarter of the amount taken by mouth may enter the circulation before this conversion.
t.E228.eff.0.a: Declared on the label above 10 mg per kilogram or per litre
t.E228.eff.0.t: May cause respiratory reactions (e.g. worsening of asthma symptoms); in the EU it must be declared on the label as an allergen
t.E228.eff.0.w: People with asthma and people sensitive to sulphites
t.E228.eff.1.t: EFSA could not establish a safe daily limit and reported a safety concern for high-consumer groups
t.E228.eff.2.a: The lowest amount that triggers a reaction is unknown
t.E228.eff.2.t: Asthma attacks, hives and angioedema (swelling of the lips, face or throat) have been reported after ingestion; most of these reactions are not true allergies
t.E228.eff.2.w: About 3–10% of people with asthma and a small number of people without asthma
t.E228.eval: A sulphite-group preservative: in the EU, products containing more than 10 mg/kg (or 10 mg/l) must declare it on the label as an allergen; it may cause reactions in people with asthma.
t.E228.prod: Produced chemically by passing sulphur dioxide through a potassium carbonate solution.
t.E228.regx.0: Temporary ADI withdrawn; a safety concern was reported for high intake.
t.E228.summary: A preservative and antioxidant that is a sulphur compound. It prevents browning and microbial growth in dried fruit, wine, vinegar and some potato products.
t.E228.what: It is a preservative and antioxidant: it prevents the growth of microorganisms and browning.
